author: L. Pfeiffer, 1839

note.en: A small snail under 7 mm that lives at the strand line among wet debris and stones, collected by INBio and listed in the Costa Rican catalogue.
note.es: Un caracol pequeño de menos de 7 mm que vive en la línea de marea entre restos húmedos y piedras, colectado por INBio y listado en el catálogo de Costa Rica.

evidence: GBIF: 4 records in the region (mostly museum specimens)

sources.t: Rodríguez Sevilla, Vargas & Cortés 2003, Gastrópodos de la costa Caribe de Costa Rica, Rev. Biol. Trop. 51 (Suppl. 3): 305-399
GBIF occurrence records (INBio and museum specimens), Gandoca to Limón

recWhy: Recorded: GBIF: 4 records in the region (mostly museum specimens).

marks.en: Tiny cylindrical, finely ribbed shell whose tip is broken off, leaving a blunt top.
marks.es: Concha diminuta, cilindrica y de costillas finas, con la punta rota que deja el apice romo.
